scope: Only the two R1 review blockers and their normal consumers

routes.finding: The membership payload is bound to a sealed result receipt with retrieval ID, content/result hashes, component source identities, observed and availability clocks. Failed refresh returns without rewriting the result or scan timestamp. Earlier reads exclude future alts; configuration majors are separately labelled.

Normal selection uses eligible Universe.symbols; explicit older cuts use fenced symbols/volumes. Detached result receipts accompany scan selection and Snapshot lineage. Explicit strategy includes are labelled strategy.universe.include, not volume-ranked membership.

Kernel passes detached membership receipts through Collector to capture. Supplied missing/future receipts exclude membership and candles. Exact source result identity survives normal Store persistence.

Real requests.get fixture exercises both actual HTTP parsers and derivation legs. Canonical spot/perp instrument identities, source endpoints, actual provider close event, local receipt/availability, request/content/revision IDs and derivation version reside in raw_json in append-only existing revisions. Availability is max of derivation and both component clocks. Recording/backfill do not backdate historical events; reopening selects only eligible stored revisions.

Normal Kernel passes explicit snapshot cut to load_derivs/DerivFeed.load. Availability-filtered revision ledger serves as-of reads; revision streams feed per-bar align. Both historical engines retain their existing replay requirement. No direct HTTP basis fallback or raw derivative projection read found in these normal consumers.
World production reads capture members_asof and bar_asof. Future membership is rejected upstream before capture; WorldState/WorldModel retain existing explicit availability/receipt/model-cut guards.
Existing signal ancestry, scan cut, source availability/observed and world-model cut checks remain. No newer result is rebound to an earlier context cut.

limitations: Offline implementation evidence; independent R2 review required. Config/strategy membership is an explicit selection, not historical provider-universe proof.
